messages:
Asha: Postmortem uploaded. Two quick customer-facing follow-ups we need owners for: statuspage copy, 72h summary, and an access policy for sharing full RCAs. Can we pick by EOD?
Mike: I can take the statuspage. Thinking short + transparent: mention impact, affected regions, and that we're mitigating root cause. No raw logs.
Jorge: I'll draft the 72h summary. Plan: tl;dr, timeline, customer impact, mitigation, next steps. Will aim for plain language.
Lina: Legal note: default to public summary + statuspage. Full RCA: only by request after privacy review and redaction; provide an outline of evidence, not raw logs, unless a customer signs an NDA and we do a redaction/inspection pass. Need a standard checklist.
incident-bot: Created action tracker ACTION-4820 and linked to postmortem: https://go/reports/ACTION-4820
Asha: Proposed owners: Mike=statuspage (ETA +6h), Jorge=72h (ETA +24h), Lina=RCA-access-policy + redaction checklist (ETA +72h). Agree?
Mike: Good. I'll include timestamps and a note: "No evidence of data access/exfiltration." Also add a short contact line for customers.
Jorge: 72h ETA confirmed: tomorrow 08:30 UTC. Will add contact details and a short "how to request more info" blurb (expected review turnaround: 5 business days).
Lina: I'll put together a one-page policy: sharing levels (public summary, sanitized RCA, full RCA under NDA), redaction checklist (PII, internal IPs, unfiltered logs), and an approval flow (legal + infra). ETA 72h.
Asha: On recurring pattern: infra flagged similar cache-eviction spikes in last 6 weeks. Recommend we tag incident with "eviction-pattern" and open a follow-up for detection thresholds and postmortem pattern review. Owner: infra-team (TBD).
Mike: I'll add the tag and suggest a short blameless note on the statuspage: "We
re investigating a recurring cache eviction pattern that contributed to load." Keep it careful.
Jorge: For customer comms batch: should we notify affected customers directly in addition to statuspage? Ops: small set (~12 customers) — direct note + offer private briefing.
Lina: Direct outreach is fine; include the redaction policy link and contact channel. For private briefings with sensitive artifacts require legal + infra sign-off and NDA when necessary.
incident-bot: ACTION-4820 updated -> owners assigned: Mike, Jorge, Lina. Follow-up task ACTION-4821 created for infra pattern review.
Asha: I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow 09:30 UTC to review drafts and close the actions. Please upload drafts to ACTION-4820 before the sync.
Mike: Will post statuspage draft in the tracker in ~4h.
Jorge: Uploading 72h draft to ACTION-4820 by 08:30 UTC tomorrow.
Lina: Policy draft will be in the tracker within 72h. Ping me if you need interim language.
Asha: Thanks all. Final ask: everyone add the SLA/contact and the "how to request full RCA" steps so customer expectations are clear.
Mike: ack.
Jorge: ack.
Lina: ack.
Asha: Closing: trackable owners + ETAs in ACTION-4820, infra follow-up ACTION-4821 for recurring pattern. See you at 09:30.
